brief:
Jerusalem's municipal electricity company announced it will cut power from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. across several areas, the Maan Wire reported. The cuts are scheduled for specific dates and affect multiple districts in the Jerusalem and Bethlehem governorates, according to the utility's statement.

The company said it regretted the necessity of the outages but provided no explanation for the reason behind the planned cuts.

title: Jerusalem electricity company announces power cuts across region
